scope: Large product-image gallery showing only parts, prices and functions in the existing GitHub Pages walkthrough

arithmetic.checks: Every quantity times unit price equals its line price; each basket equals its line sum; observed and estimated splits reconcile with dated source records.

verification.syntax: web/app.js, web/parts.js and web/parts-data.js passed node --check
verification.source_validation: Passed; pinned SONIC v1 manuscript checksum unchanged
verification.browser: Installed Chrome via bundled Playwright, local HTTP preview
verification.layout_scope: All five lists at all four widths: no page horizontal overflow, no missing or broken images, no browser script errors or local HTTP failures. Three columns on desktop, two on tablet, one on phone. Image areas are at least 236 pixels wide in the checked layouts (previous desktop thumbnails were 100 pixels wide).
interactions: Every line item and quantity displayed
Each list total and candidate-only subtotal
Original McGinley diagram and parts-slide links
Default home and entry to parts list
Grouped parts preserve the exact source item set without omissions or duplicates
verification.visual_inspection: Grouped desktop Basic and McGinley galleries inspected; all five lists checked at desktop, tablet and phone widths. Captures remain ignored temporary files.

images: All 37 unique listed parts have sourced product images; no placeholder icons remain. Two NI accessory photos are visibly marked Reference photo. Per-file URLs, family-photo limits and configuration caveats are in web/assets/parts/sources.json.
evidence_boundary: Prices are dated planning observations/estimates. Equipment inventory, borrowed availability, recorder interfaces, source-to-speaker bandwidth, acoustic accuracy and neural alignment remain unverified. OmniMic is a separate USB calibration candidate, not a validated direct-NI microphone replacement. Rice sedation differs from the awake SONIC preparation.
actions: Website implementation and software/source checks only. No vendor contact, order, sound playback, hardware control, bench work or animal experiment.

mcginley_screenshots.coverage: All 10 sound-chain parts from the original slides are present with pictures, as are the 7 measurement/accessory additions in the 17-line basket. Reused desktop and own neural recorder remain outside the priced sound basket.
mcginley_screenshots.status: Original saved images inspected; preserved unchanged and linked from the McGinley tab.

organization.ordering: Waveform source and sound hardware first; microphone/calibration hardware next; interfaces, cables and power last. The two budget candidates remain a simple two-part gallery.
organization.coverage: Browser verification compares rendered product IDs to every source item: no missing or duplicated parts in any list; photos, quantities and totals preserved.
